recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not remove canonical-reference version-search guidance under References and Versions unless a separate final Jira decision changes canonical/reference search behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-34398 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 change request to remove guidance from the URI search type section saying servers SHOULD support canonical-reference searches and automatically detect a piped |[version] suffix for canonical resource URLs.
initial_application: Upstream commit 644133ce9f4e090ead029bac99b78fb69bdb7b2d applied the issue by deleting the quoted URI-section sentence from source/search.html.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread distinguishes URI URL-property searches such as ValueSet.url from canonical-reference searches; later FHIR-37382 and FHIR-52936 intentionally preserve versioned canonical syntax in reference/canonical contexts and clarify that reference is generally preferred for versioned canonical values.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/search.html no longer contains the removed URI guidance or ValueSet?url=http://foo|v1-style recommendation, and the remaining canonical-reference version prose belongs to later final decisions outside FHIR-34398's URI-scope removal.

related_jiras.note: Retracted precursor that bundled _profile cleanup, the URI/canonical table question, and the same URI guidance; FHIR-34398 became the focused final removal request.
Published issue requiring [url]|[version] syntax documentation only for reference search parameters associated with canonical elements.
Applied R6 clarification that URI search can be used with canonical/uri/url elements while reference is generally preferred for versioned canonical values.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue requesting removal of URI search guidance that suggested servers SHOULD detect a piped |[version] suffix for canonical resource URLs.
evidence_items.learned: The final WG decision was to remove that URI-type guidance because the behavior is not predictable.

evidence_items.summary: The active URI section describes ordinary URI matching, URL hierarchy modifiers, and says reference is preferred for versioned canonical values.
evidence_items.learned: The removed SHOULD guidance for URI search parameters is absent from the current source.

evidence_items.summary: Upstream commit FHIR-34398 removed the quoted URI guidance from source/search.html.

evidence_items.summary: The linked thread distinguishes ValueSet.url URI searches from canonical-reference searches and contains the request to raise FHIR-34398.
evidence_items.learned: Community discussion supports a narrow URI-search removal rather than removal of all canonical version-search syntax.

evidence_items.summary: Published issue adding [parameter]=[url]|[version] documentation for reference search parameters when the search element is canonical.
evidence_items.learned: Later final Jira context explains why canonical-reference version-search prose remains valid after FHIR-34398.
